canDoYue: 你識趕急刻金手鈪、普通刻字趕得切星期六婚禮、傍晚先睇校對稿，同埋問急單收費。
canDoEn: Ask to rush gold-bracelet lettering before Saturday morning, hear that plain lettering finishes in time for the wedding, check one proof that evening, and ask the rush fee for one change.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Could you rush the lettering on this gold bracelet before Saturday morning?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以喺星期六朝早之前，趕急刻呢隻金手鈪嘅字？
dialogue.say: Could you rush the lettering on this gold bracelet before Saturday morning?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. I can rush that gold bracelet lettering, and Saturday morning still works.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。我可以趕急刻嗰隻金手鈪，星期六朝早都得。
dialogue.say: Yes. I can rush that gold bracelet lettering, and Saturday morning still works.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Will plain lettering finish in time if our wedding stays on Saturday?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果婚禮係星期六，普通刻字趕唔趕得切？
dialogue.say: Will plain lettering finish in time if our wedding stays on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. Plain lettering will finish in time, so the wedding can stay on Saturday.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。普通刻字趕得切，婚禮可以照星期六。
dialogue.say: Yes. Plain lettering will finish in time, so the wedding can stay on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can I check one proof of those words before you cut the bracelet?
dialogue.glossYue: 切之前，可唔可以畀我睇一次校對稿？
dialogue.say: Can I check one proof of those words before you cut the bracelet?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. I will email that proof this evening before we cut it.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。我會喺傍晚電郵嗰份校對稿，切之前交。
dialogue.say: Yes. I will email that proof this evening before we cut it.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: What is the rush fee if that proof comes back with one change?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果校對稿要改一次，急單收費幾多？
dialogue.say: What is the rush fee if that proof comes back with one change?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yes. The rush fee is eighty dollars, and one proof change is free.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。急單收費八十蚊，改一次校對稿免費。
dialogue.say: Yes. The rush fee is eighty dollars, and one proof change is free.
